newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FOCUS-Akzo Q2 net surges 25 percent.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Akzo Q2 net surges 25 percent.

text.p: Dutch chemicals giant Akzo Nobel NV on Thursday reported a 25 percent surge in second quarter net profits, which easily beat analysts forecasts, and repeated a forecast that full year profit would be higher.

The company said net profit rose to 459 million guilders ($222.1 million) during the period from 367 million in the second quarter of 1996. Analysts had anticipated the group would report second quarter profit of 375-427 million.
Half year net rose to 799 million guilders from 699 million, again beating forecasts which ranged from 715 million to 768 million.

"Second quarter earnings of consolidated and nonconsolidated companies improved significantly. Therefore Akzo Nobel stands by its forecast that net income for 1997 will be higher than in the record year 1996," the company said in a statement with results.
For the whole of 1996 Akzo Nobel made a net profit of 1.318 billion guilders.
Akzo said second quarter sales rose 10 percent in cash terms to 6.2 billion guilders, mainly as a result of an eight percent increase in sales volumes.
Currency translations had a positive effect of five percent on sales, while average selling prices were down one percent. On balance divestments and acquisitions cut sales by two percent.
In its divisions, pharmaceuticals saw operating income rise mainly due to higher volumes for Organon, Intervet and Diosynth.

Earnings in all coatings business units were up significantly, reflecting higher volumes sold and recovered margins, the company said. Business units are now better equipped to respond to the developments in the coatings market, it added.
Chemicals results also improved, mainly due to increased sales at Polymer Chemicals and Surface Chemistry.

Fibres saw a better than anticipated contribution from Industrial Fibres but the group continues to suffer from worldwide overcapacity in the industry, which is weighing on selling prices, the company said. ($ = 2.066 Dutch Guilders)
